defects.about: The long-side windows are a continuous strip of 7, where the source has 4 separate windows. The roof windows are missing.
The two chimneys are missing or barely visible.

observations.seen: The plan front is the long side, with the terrace on the left and 4 windows on the ground floor. It matches picture 3, which shows 4 windows with a timber band and 3 roof windows. The model shows a continuous strip of 7 windows and no roof windows on the front slope.

Gable roof with the ridge running along the long axis, as in the drawings. The model's RIGHT and LEFT gable ends are correct. The model has no dormers or roof windows, and the source has small roof windows on both long slopes.
The source shows two chimneys on the ridge. The model has only thin slivers.

The source gable ends have a small square upper window and a timber panel inside a white frame. The model's gable ends have a wide upper window and its ground-floor windows are wide strips. The source end has a door on one end and a glazed door on the other.

reviewed.note: The main roof is a gable with the ridge along the long axis, as in the drawings.
